terms.gloss: a felt-tip pen; literally a felt pen
evidence: M-O s.v. pen: marker: felt-tip pen
terms.comment: Morgan–Owens’s word, on calamus, a reed pen, and an adjective from coāctilia, felt (see “felt”); the adjective is not in Lewis & Short.

phrases.latin: Nōlī calamīs coāctiliciīs in mēnsā pingere: in chartā pinge.
phrases.english: Don’t draw on the table with the felt-tips: draw on the paper.
Put the cap on the pen so it doesn’t dry out.

sources: Lewis & Short: calamus · Lewis & Short: coactilis
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. pen: marker: felt-tip pen.
